name: net_link_lost_while_loading_rejoins
description: Two seats; client 1 is slow to load and the match waits for every seat, so the match still loads when client 2, which has loaded, loses its link (a dropped Wi-Fi, a router's restart) and its new links are refused for a while. It keeps its world and reconnects every 2 s with a resume HELLO naming its seat, as it would mid-match; the sequencer, as the server does, takes the seat back while the match loads and sends MATCH_CONFIG as at the start (no rejoin flag), and the game says LOADED again over the new link. The match starts once client 1 has loaded and plays with both seats: no overlay, orders going out, the seat never AWAY and the hashes agreeing.

steps.msg: client 2 has loaded; client 1 still loads
its link lost while the match loads, it keeps its world and reconnects, naming its seat
meanwhile it says it is reconnecting

steps.assert: back and scene.client(2).phase_name() == 'LOADING' and scene.seq.rejoins == 1 and scene.seq.no_held_seat == 0
steps.msg: the seat was taken back while the match loads: a plain MATCH_CONFIG, and it said LOADED again
back on its link: the overlay shows nothing, and nothing was refused
the sequencer has its LOADED again, and the match still waits for client 1
it plays its seat: no overlay, its orders go out
the seat never went AWAY: it was loaded again when the match started
